type: List.{0} (Set.{0} Nat) → Prop

name: GenLimit.ListIdentification.HasAngluinStratification
type: {α : Type u_1} → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily.{u_1} α → Nat → Prop
value:
fun {α} F k =>
  ∃ layers,
    And (Eq.{1} (List.length.{0} layers) k)
      (And (GenLimit.ListIdentification.CoversAllIndices layers)
        (∀ (I : Set.{0} Nat),
          Membership.mem.{0, 0} layers I → GenLimit.ListIdentification.RelativeConditionTwo.{u_1} F I))

name: GenLimit.ListIdentification.IsRelativeTellTale
type: {α : Type u_1} → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily.{u_1} α → Set.{0} Nat → Nat → Finset.{u_1} α → Prop
value:
fun {α} F I i T =>
  And (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} (↑T) (F i))
    (∀ (j : Nat),
      Membership.mem.{0, 0} I j →
        HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} (↑T) (F j) → HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} (F j) (F i) → HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} (F i) (F j))

name: GenLimit.ListIdentification.Psi
type: {α : Type u_1} → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily.{u_1} α → Nat → Nat → Prop
value:
fun {α} F i x =>
  Nat.brecOn.{1} (motive := fun x => Nat → Prop) x
    (fun x f i =>
      (match (motive := (x : Nat) → Nat.below.{1} (motive := fun x => Nat → Prop) x → Prop) x with
        | 0 => fun x => False
        | Nat.succ k => fun x =>
          ∃ T,
            And (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} (↑T) (F i))
              (∀ (j : Nat), HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} (↑T) (F j) → HasSSubset.SSubset.{u_1} (F j) (F i) → x.1 j))
        f)
    i

fun {α} F I =>
  ∀ (i : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} I i → ∃ T, GenLimit.ListIdentification.IsRelativeTellTale.{u_1} F I i T
